primary_claim: The empirical NTK (eNTK) eigenspectrum exhibits sharp cliffs whose top eigenspaces align with ground-truth features in Toy Models of Superposition and a modular-arithmetic MLP, and the evolution of the eNTK spectrum can be used to track the grokking phase transition.

effect.metric: cosine similarity alignment between top eNTK eigenvectors and ground-truth feature vectors
effect.value: top eNTK eigenvectors align with ground-truth features in both sparse and dense TMS regimes, and with Fourier feature families after grokking in the modular arithmetic model

contradicts_or_qualifies: The current SAE paradigm for interpreting linear combinations of within-layer neurons is 'essentially a guess'; eNTK analysis is proposed as an alternative practical handle for feature discovery
stated_future_work: Extend the eNTK analysis pipeline to Transformers, first small then increasingly large and realistic language models
limitations_stated: It is not known in general when the empirical NTK hypothesis is and isn't true
Realistic models are usually not in the theoretically controllable (wide, lazy-limit) NTK regime
Results could be a fluke specific to the toy models studied rather than generalizing
quote: we find that the top eigenvectors of the eNTK align with ground-truth features in toy models where the ground-truth features are known.
